answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: I'm glad the shift could work for you. The office will help with any other questions after this call. Would you like to accept this shift?

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: Thanks for letting me know you need some time to think about it. I appreciate your time, and feel free to reach out when you're ready. Have a great day!
